title: audit-signal-model-and-delta-encoding-for-rbac-v2-with-sso-linkage
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define a compact, extensible audit event model and a delta-based change encoding (delta-lite-v2) for RBAC v2 admin operations, with SSO/SAML linkage for actor provenance. Deliverables: schema spec, redaction rules, sampling/retention classes, canonical diff encoding, and a migration plan for existing audit consumers.
decisions: 1) Adopt a single envelope event with typed payload variants (admin_change, auth_flow, policy_eval). 2) Use delta-lite-v2 for diffs: field-level ops (set/add/remove) with contextual mapping to allow sparse storage and cheap reconstitution. 3) Persist both compact delta and full snapshot on P0 admin ops for 90 days; keep deltas thereafter. 4) Anchor actor provenance to SAML assertion IDs and session IDs when available; fallback to actor_id + actor_source with confidence score.
implementation_notes:
- Event envelope keys: event_id, event_type, timestamp, actor_id, actor_source, actor_confidence, saml_assertion_id, session_id, target_type, target_id, delta_encoding, delta_payload_base64, snapshot_base64_optional, retention_class, integrity_hmac, ingestion_pipeline_version.
- Delta encoding: compact JSON lines representing operations: {op:set,path:/role,id:role_123,from:[old],to:[new]}. Support nested structure diffs for composite objects (policy.rule[].conditions).
- Redaction: sensitive fields (email, ip, saml_assertion_raw) must be stored in redacted form using reversible KMS wrapping where audit-readers explicitly authorized; otherwise store irreversible hash.
- Sampling: high-frequency low-risk ops (token refresh, non-privileged role reads) apply 1% sampling and aggregated telemetry; admin_privilege_changes and policy_grants are never sampled.
